name: 💣 Ragdoll Destruction Playground
desc:
Interactive physics sandbox featuring ragdolls and world destruction
Have fun wrecking the world and playing with intelligent ragdolls!

*Dont forget to reset your map when you're ready to cause more destruction!*


⏰ NEW UPDATE!💣
* MINIGUN + CHAINSAW *
* SLOW MOTION * ⏰
* Epic time slow down! Play with some amazing moments!
* Added explosives, several more weapons, props and unlockable items! NPC behaviours and much more! *
* Play with Insane explosions and fire! *

*Multiplayer is planned* follow and like the game for updates ;)
Early in development! Leave your feedback!

llm.loop: spawn into a private sandbox -> use weapons and explosives on ragdoll NPCs and the world -> unlock items -> reset map and repeat
llm.objectives: cause destruction and play with ragdolls
llm.instructions: wreck the world and ragdolls; reset the map to cause more destruction
llm.thumbnails: ragdoll icon, explosion UPDATE banner, chainsaw and lightsaber cutting trees
llm.complexity_notes: destructible environment, ragdoll NPC behaviour, many tools; single-player server
